title: PHPlus Project Configuration
description: Configuration for a PHPlus project. Paths are relative to the project root.

$schema.description: Location of the JSON Schema used by editors and validation tools.

source.description: Project directories containing PHP and PHPlus source files.

output.description: Compiler-owned directory for generated production PHP.

cache.description: Compiler-owned directory for temporary and cached artifacts.

targetPhpVersion.description: PHP version targeted by generated source for the MVP.

stubs.description: Optional directories containing PHPlus interoperability stubs.

exclude.description: Paths excluded from project source discovery.
